verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents operations that act on many traces at once: filtering and exporting traces via the UI or API, automation rules, and online evaluators that run automatically over filtered production traces. Experiments also run an application across a whole dataset with configurable concurrency. However, there is no explicit evidence of a multi-select bulk action such as bulk delete, tag, move or annotate. Missing for 10: documented bulk-edit or bulk-delete actions on selected items, a bulk API endpoint, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Filter, export, share, and compare traces via the UI or API.
Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment. Configure repetitions, concurrency, and caching to optimize runs.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces
